# Workers Compensation Exemptions

> Workers Compensation Exemptions (by Contractors Choice Agency) is the comprehensive guide to workers' compensation exemptions across all 50 states. Topics covered: LLC member exemptions (single-member and multi-member, by state), family member exemptions (spouse, children, parents), independent contractor classification (ABC test, economic reality test, California AB5), corporate officer exclusion rules, seasonal worker coverage rules, alternative WC solutions (Texas non-subscriber, occupational accident insurance, PEOs), and exemption compliance audits. Licensed agency, founded 2005, NPN #8608479, licensed in all 50 states. 15-minute response. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.

## Service guides

- [State-by-State Exemption Guide](/services/state-exemption-guide): The definitive guide to workers' comp exemption rules in all 50 states — filing requirements, renewal deadlines, eligible parties, and industry restrictions.
- [LLC Member Exemption Rules](/services/llc-member-exemption): How LLC member exemptions work in every state — single-member vs. multi-member, manager-managed vs. member-managed, construction restrictions, and renewal requirements.
- [Family Member Exemptions](/services/family-member-exemption): Spouse, children, and parent exemptions in family-owned businesses — by state, by business structure, and the risks of an uninsured family injury.
- [Independent Contractor Classification](/services/independent-contractor): ABC test, economic reality test, California AB5, Florida subcontractor documentation, misclassification penalties, and audit triggers.
- [Corporate Officer Exemption](/services/corporate-officer-exemption): Officer exclusion rules by state — stock ownership thresholds, officer count limits, qualifying titles, and renewal requirements.
- [Seasonal Worker Rules](/services/seasonal-worker-rules): Seasonal, part-time, and H-2A agricultural worker coverage requirements and how seasonal layoffs affect policy audits.
- [Alternative WC Solutions](/services/alternative-wc-solutions): Texas non-subscriber, occupational accident insurance, PEOs, state fund (assigned risk), and DBA coverage for government contractors.
- [Exemption Compliance Audit](/services/compliance-audit): Audit triggers, what auditors look for, retroactive voiding of exemptions, civil and criminal penalties, and how to prepare.

## Key state pages

- [Florida WC Exemptions](/locations/florida): Construction exemption rules, annual renewal, 10-officer cap, high enforcement volume.
- [Texas WC Non-Subscriber](/locations/texas): Non-subscriber system, occupational accident alternatives, TDI-DWC oversight.
- [California WC Exemptions](/locations/california): AB5, LLC exemption limits, DIR enforcement, strict coverage requirements.
- [New York WC Exemptions](/locations/new-york): WC board filings, construction industry rules, out-of-state worker coverage.
- [Georgia WC Exemptions](/locations/georgia): LLC member exemptions, sole proprietor rules, subcontractor compliance.
- [Arizona WC Exemptions](/locations/arizona): Corporate officer and LLC exemptions, ICA enforcement, construction market.
- [Illinois WC Exemptions](/locations/illinois): Strict subcontractor rules, family business exemptions, corporate officer rules.
- [North Carolina WC Exemptions](/locations/north-carolina): Construction subcontractor exemption challenges, NCLB oversight.
